title: Siege of Mézières
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Mézières", at revision 1369576514, opens: "The siege of Mézières took place in 1521, during the Italian War of 1521–1526. The town was besieged by an army of the Holy Roman Empire. Mézières was defended by French troops under the command of Pierre Terrail, seigneur de Bayard and Anne de Montmorency." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7879248, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1521 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
